author: claude
description: 34x25x19 festival plaza (ground_level 1) built by load()ing other library entries: a CheeseWheel pavilion (cheese_wheel@2), two TetheredBalloons wrapping HotAirBalloon (hot_air_balloon@1) on chain tethers, and a RuneStone (viking_longhouse@1), plus three market stalls facing north, benches, flower beds, a round tree, lantern posts and a glowing sign. Exports FestivalPaving(width, length, skip) - a bordered diagonal-lattice paving that leaves `skip` cells unpaved for round buildings - and TetheredBalloon(height, color_a, color_b) (7 x height+12 x 7). Open to the south and west.
name: cheese_festival_square
title: Cheese Festival Square
